question: Which of the following was released by the Reserve Bank of India in January 2025 to streamline credit information frameworks?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Credit Information Reporting Directions, 2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** issued the **Credit Information Reporting Directions, 2025**, in **January 2025** to streamline and strengthen the framework for credit data reporting across the country.
 
• These directions are designed to improve the **accuracy, completeness, and timeliness** of credit information provided by **Credit Institutions (CIs)** to **Credit Information Companies (CICs)**.
 
• The primary objective of this framework is to consolidate various existing instructions and circulars into a single, comprehensive set of guidelines to ensure **uniformity** in reporting practices.
 
• The directions mandate that **Credit Institutions** (such as banks and NBFCs) must report credit information to all **four functional CICs** in India on a regular basis, typically **fortnightly** or as specified by the regulator.
